mathematical_authority.pair_point: The point remains the existing BezierAlgebraicCuspChordDerivedPoint2 handle. Its local semicircle parameter bracket and selected center isolator are refined independently, then the exact rational semicircle map is interval-evaluated. Lost dependency can only widen the box.
mathematical_authority.original_identity: First-side and second-side parameters sharing one pair-map allocation and contact identify the same original affine point only while radial scale is one and translation is zero. Images about different centers are never equated structurally.
mathematical_authority.tangent_cross: The pair map owns T_first x T_second. Each concentric image contributes the exact sign of current_radius*source_radius and each reversed fragment contributes one sign reversal.
mathematical_authority.bevel_direction: For Q_i=C_i+s(P-C_i)+T, equal s and T cancel P exactly: Q_2-Q_1=(1-s)(C_2-C_1). Exact rational centers are normalized under STRICT and stored only in the chord's existing direction evidence.
mathematical_authority.opposite_circle_incidence: For Q_j tested against the scaled opposite circle, |Q_j-C_i|^2-s^2*r_i^2=(1-s)[s(r_i^2-r_j^2)+|C_j-C_i|^2]. Equal source radii leave sign(1-s) because a pair contact already proves positive center separation.
mathematical_authority.complement_exclusion: If one bevel endpoint is on a supporting circle and the other is strictly inside, disk convexity permits only the on-circle endpoint. A direct interior pair parameter on one selected half is excluded from the same-frame carrier with negated signed radius and unchanged traversal sense; diameter endpoints are deliberately not classified by this proof.
mathematical_authority.persistent_representation: No public carrier, primitive element, compatibility shim, or duplicate engine was added. Selected-circle fragments, derived points, chords, and regions remain shared one-word handles.

authority_routes.regularization: CurveRegionBooleanContext::pair_result -> adjacent endpoint certificate / complementary-pair endpoint exclusion / existing exact pair kernel

policy_evidence.strict: Persistent point identity, tangent signs, chord direction, incidence, and complementary-half exclusion are structural or resolved under CurveContext::STRICT. Unresolved predicates remain typed uncertainty.
policy_evidence.approximate_512: APPROXIMATE_512 remains a terminal equality policy after 512-bit refinement. It cannot create a coordinate, pair identity, chord direction, or incidence certificate.
policy_evidence.fixture_outcome: STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512 both return CurveCertainty::Certified, proving this supportable fixture consumes no approximate terminal.

capability_fixture.geometry: The intersection lens of two independently selected unit circles centered at (0,0) and (1,0). Upper and complementary lower selected halves are clipped at the two interior pair contacts.
capability_fixture.operation: Build four exact selected-circle fragments, offset the material boundary outward by 1/8 with bevel corners, and regularize through CurveRegion2.
capability_fixture.current_result: Certified with one nonempty exact six-fragment retained boundary under STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512.
capability_fixture.historical_result: The byte-matched 746c6bc implementation constructs the lens but returns complete=false when offset point evidence reaches the unsupported pair-mapped cut.
capability_fixture.competitive_fixture: Cavalier Contours receives the equivalent binary64 two-bulge lens with bulge=1/sqrt(3) and offset -0.125.

benchmark_method.wall: Nine fresh processes pinned to CPU 11 per Hyper mode, each with 64 timed operations after one warm-up and one preflight. Cavalier uses 65536 timed operations after 128 warm-ups for timer stability.
benchmark_method.perf: One pinned perf-stat process per artifact and matched disabled control, with 64 timed operations, one warm-up, and one preflight. Counts are control-subtracted and divided by 66.
benchmark_method.heap: Heaptrack record-only uses eight timed operations, one warm-up, and one preflight. Recorder counts are control-subtracted and divided by ten. Valgrind Massif compares one timed prebuilt operation plus preflight with its matched control.
benchmark_method.size: Identically configured all-feature and no-default release unit-test executables; actual .text is read from size -A.
benchmark_method.historical_caveat: Historical end-to-end measures fresh exact rejection, not a completed correctness-equivalent operation. Historical prebuilt calls hit the cached blocker after preflight and are reported only as cache behavior.
benchmark_method.competitive_caveat: Cavalier Contours 0.7.0 uses binary64 bulge geometry and supplies no selected algebraic fields, Hyper policy outcome, retained proof, or guarantee-equivalent regularization. It is throughput context only.

wall_performance.interpretation: The exact successful operation costs 9.59 ms. Construction is 4.86% of that median and is 8.40% slower than the historical matched build. Historical and Cavalier paths do materially less and are not correctness-equivalent.

deterministic_perf.interpretation: A repeated successful exact offset retires 91.39M instructions. Fresh end-to-end success retires 97.12M instructions. Historical rejection is construction-dominated at 4.54M instructions.

allocation_evidence.interpretation: The successful prebuilt exact offset makes 191.7k allocation calls and adds 334,960 bytes of peak heap over its matched control. Persistent carrier layouts remain unchanged; temporary exact polynomial and Rational work dominates.

linked_size.interpretation: The all-feature predicate capability adds 26,720 actual text bytes. Dead stripping makes no-default .text and allocated size byte-identical to historical.
